summary: Black Duck Defensics black-box fuzzing for device and software makers: it floods protocols and formats with malformed data and finds unknown vulnerabilities.
value: Zero-day vulnerabilities in network protocols and formats are found before the product ships.
No access to source code is needed.
More than 300 ready-made test suites plug into development and CI.
simple: Black-box fuzzing for device and software makers: floods network protocols, file formats and interfaces with malformed data and finds crashes and zero-day vulnerabilities without access to source code. 300+ ready, continuously maintained test suites with RFC specification coverage; protocol bundles for specific industries; APIs for automation in the development process and CI. Black Duck is the former Synopsys Software Integrity Group, an independent company since October 2024.
classification: We count fuzzing within the DAST (dynamic application testing) class.
